title: cwf-chaotic-womens
label: Faith

won.source: Its own Women's title-history page: Faith defeated Roxie Michaels, 15 March 2005, CWF Shockwave.

how: Won the Women's title at Shockwave from Roxie Michaels; its own Hall of Fame page calls her the first Women's champion.

title: cwf-chaotic-womens
label: Dana Morris

won.source: Its own Women's title-history page: Dana Morris defeated Faith, 1 May 2005, CWF Impact.

how: Beat Faith at CWF Impact; the title page ends at this line.
note: The reigns between this one and Syd Ashley's are not in the surviving record.

title: cwf-chaotic-womens
label: Syd Ashley

won.source: Genocide's own Women's title gauntlet: Syd Ashley pins Faith after the Air Canada.

how: Won the gauntlet match, the last to enter, from the champion Faith.
note: Ultimate Chaos bills her as the former Women's champion; the match in which she lost it is not in the surviving record.

title: cwf-chaotic-womens
label: Faith

won.source: Ultimate Chaos (3 April 2007) bills Faith as the Women's champion, and Syd Ashley as the former champion; the night Faith regained it between those two broadcasts is not in the surviving record.

how: Champion again on the last broadcast.

title: cwf-chaotic-international
label: Christian Connolly

won.source: Genocide's own 60 minute Iron Man match: Christian Connolly beats Fuel five falls to four.

how: Won a 60 minute Iron Man match; his own Hall of Fame page lists the International title among his wins.
note: Fuel's reign is not structured: its start is not dated in the surviving record. X-Factor is champion by Ultimate Chaos and the night he won it is not recorded.

title: cwf-chaotic-international
label: The Punk

won.source: Ultimate Chaos's own International title match: The Punk beats X-Factor with a Punk DDT.

how: Won the title from X-Factor after a back-and-forth match.

won.source: Ultimate Chaos (3 April 2007) bills X-Factor as the International champion; the night he won it between Genocide and that show is not in the surviving record.

title: cwf-chaotic-cruiserweight
label: Michael Machete

won.source: Champion on both Genocide (22 October 2006) and Ultimate Chaos (3 April 2007); the night he won it is not in the surviving record.

how: Kept the title against Ken Sandwave and Carnage at Genocide and against Neptune at Ultimate Chaos.

title: cwf-chaotic-world-heavyweight
label: Priest

won.source: Champion on both Genocide (22 October 2006) and Ultimate Chaos (3 April 2007). Ultimate Chaos says both that he has held it since winning it from the Suntan Superman 'last May' and that he has carried the belt 'since September'; Genocide says X-Factor took it from him at Bloodbath and he is champion again.

how: Kept the title against X-Factor at Genocide and against John Thomas at Ultimate Chaos.
note: The broadcasts give two starting points for this reign, May and September, with X-Factor's title win at Bloodbath between them; no date is filed.

title: cwf-chaotic-tag-team
label: The Hit Squad

won.source: Champions on Genocide (22 October 2006), billed as the current reigning and defending Tag Team champions; the night they won the titles is not in the surviving record.

how: Kept the titles in a three-team point elimination match at Genocide.
note: Ultimate Chaos bills them as the former champions.

title: cwf-chaotic-tag-team
label: Generation Xtreme

won.source: Ultimate Chaos (3 April 2007) bills Generation Xtreme as the Tag Team champions; the night they won the titles from the Hit Squad is not in the surviving record.

how: Kept the titles in a triple threat tag match against the Hit Squad and the New Two Man Power Trip.
